text: ぜひ　ともだちと　いっしょに　あそびに　きてくれ！

structure.jp: ともだちと　いっしょに
あそびに　きてくれ！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に after the stem of a verb, followed by a verb of coming or going, says what you come or go to do. あそびに　きて = 'come to play'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone does the thing as a favor to the speaker. くれ is its blunt order form. きてくれ = 'come (for me)!'
